caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers with a reddish-brown finish. The chest stands on four short legs and has straight, clean lines. There are a total of six visible drawers on the top, arranged in two rows of three smaller drawers each, with two medium-sized drawers below them. Below these, there is a single long drawer that is pulled out and converted into a writing desk with a drop-down front panel, which is supported by two brass-colored metal arms on either side. The interior of the drop-down section is a lighter yellow-brown wood and consists of smaller cubbyhole compartments divided by thin vertical dividers. Beneath the drop-down section, there are two large drawers positioned one above the other, both featuring round dark knobs as handles. The chest is shown against an off-white or pale beige background with no other objects present.
title: Shaker Desk
